Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                            ORDINANCE

RE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit Detached House District
symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 15-0 in the area bounded by


       West Olive Avenue; North Harlem Avenue; West Bryn Mawr Avenue;
       and the alley next west of and parallel to North Harlem Avenue,


to those ofa B3-1 Community Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and elTect from and after its passage

and due publication.
